title: 3D Interactive Media Development
content:
Unity Animator Controller

The Animator Controller controls animation through layers with state machines, controlled by parameters.

The Animator Component is added to an object to be animated.
It acts as a constructor

Variables:
	Layers – Layers of animations in the controller window.
		The Layer has a visual State Machine that controls the model’s animations
	Parameters – expose control by script (Speed), transitions and blendtrees

Transitions, Masks, Logic and Booleans

title: 3D Interactive Media Development
content:
Unity Animation System (Animator) Workflow

Based on Animation Clips – usually imported
Organised in Animator Controller flowchart
Can be basic or complex (for whole player animations)
Avatar system allows humanoid retargeting as well as muscle definitions

Animator Component in a Game Object has:
	1. Animation Clips
	2. Animator Controller
	3. Avatar

These are defined and adjusted in the inspector window in the top level of an imported fbx.

Animator Component references the Animator Controller, which references the Animation Clips used.
